notes: Every list on the site goes through this component. Items render through Text atom. Icon variant uses Icon atom for decorative markers. No animation. All 4 renders use List.astro — pipeline strips icon prop in textonly (native bullets replace). Assistive render: all variants normalise to vertical stacked with large dot markers, icons hidden. Textonly render: native disc/decimal bullets, icons hidden, inline collapses to vertical.

contentList.description: Array of items. Pipeline content key. Each item is either a string (plain text) or { contentLink, href } (linked item).

icon.description: Phosphor icon slug for simple icon markers (fallback). Stripped in textonly, native bullets replace. Ignored if media is set.

media._description: Rich marker atom — overrides the default bullet/icon/dot markers. Each list item renders its own instance.
Nested atom node. Child atom owns its own props (colour, size, animation, background). Shape can wrap an Icon. LottieIcon excluded — use an animated Icon instead.

text._description: Text atom props for item text — spread onto each nested Text. Accepts any Text prop (color, family, size, weight, leading, uppercase, etc). List sets 'as=span' and 'flush' internally.

textStyle._description: Forwarded to the Text atom. See Text.schema.json for the full prop list — all Text props are valid here except 'as' and 'flush' which are controlled by List.

color.description: Colour variant for markers, icons, and dots. 'text' = body text scale (always readable).

colour._description: Pipeline colour tokens — set as inline styles. 'auto' = pipeline resolves from context.
